_note: Tone tags for the report's chef.state field. No illustration is shown in the report.

chef-default.when: A calm, ordinary week with no standout theme. The safe fallback.

chef-cooking.when: The week's story is something made: a build, a prototype, a plan taking shape.

chef-celebrating.when: A clear win: something shipped, a decision landed well, recognition earned.

chef-burnt.when: The week's story is something that went sideways or was needlessly complicated.

chef-juggling.when: A good week and a chaotic one at once: many things in flight and most of them kept up.

chef-thinking.when: A week of questions, decisions, investigation or changed assumptions.

chef-relaxed.when: A calm, steady or light week, or one with a lot of recovery in it.

chef-surprised.when: An unexpected turn: a surprise outcome, a reversal, something nobody planned.
